```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# Install once, if needed:
# install.packages(c("leaflet", "htmlwidgets", "dplyr"))

library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)

places <- data.frame(
  name = c(
    "Manipal",
    "Udupi Sri Krishna Matha",
    "Malpe Beach",
    "Kapu Lighthouse"
  ),
  lat = c(13.35000, 13.34118, 13.36197, 13.2239132),
  lng = c(74.78333, 74.75201, 74.69753, 74.7367936),
  category = c("Education town", "Heritage", "Coast", "Coastal landmark"),
  details = c(
    "A university town in Udupi district, Karnataka.",
    "A historic Krishna temple and matha in Udupi.",
    "A coastal beach near Udupi, known for its fishing harbour and sea views.",
    "A historic lighthouse on the Arabian Sea coast near Kaup (Kapu)."
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

places$popup <- paste0(
  "<strong>", places$name, "</strong><br>",
  "<em>", places$category, "</em><br>",
  places$details
)
```

# Explore the Udupi coast

**Created November 7, 2026 · Udupi district, Karnataka, India**

This interactive map highlights four places across the Manipal–Udupi coastal area. Select a marker to read a short description, zoom in for local detail, or drag the map to explore the surrounding coastline.

```{r leaflet-map}
leaflet(data = places, options = leafletOptions( preferCanvas = TRUE )) %>%
  addTiles(
    urlTemplate = "https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png",
    attribution = "&copy; <a href='https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright'>OpenStreetMap</a> contributors",
    options = tileOptions(noWrap = TRUE, maxZoom = 19)
  ) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lng,
    lat = ~lat,
    radius = 7,
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 2,
    color = "#ffffff",
    fillColor = "#176b87",
    fillOpacity = 0.95,
    popup = ~popup,
    label = ~name
  ) %>%
  fitBounds(
    lng1 = min(places$lng) - 0.04,
    lat1 = min(places$lat) - 0.025,
    lng2 = max(places$lng) + 0.025,
    lat2 = max(places$lat) + 0.025
  )
```

## Places on the map

- **Manipal** — a university town east of Udupi.
- **Udupi Sri Krishna Matha** — a major historic temple in the city of Udupi.
- **Malpe Beach** — a beach on the Arabian Sea coast.
- **Kapu Lighthouse** — a coastal lighthouse near Kaup/Kapu.

*Map tiles are provided by OpenStreetMap contributors. An internet connection is required to load the interactive basemap. Standard OpenStreetMap tile usage rules apply; do not bulk-download or use the tiles for offline prefetching.*
